import sys, subprocess, pathlib, json, datetime, os
card, label, *command = sys.argv[1:]
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/-MGAR-v2-'); out=root/'evidence/batches'/card; out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy(); env['PATH']='/workspace/.mgar-tools/go/bin:'+str(root/'.venv/bin')+':'+env['PATH']; env['GOTOOLCHAIN']='local'; env['GOMAXPROCS']='4'; env['GOCACHE']='/workspace/.mgar-tools/gocache'; env['GOPATH']='/workspace/.mgar-tools/gopath'; env['UV_CACHE_DIR']='/workspace/.mgar-tools/uv-cache'; env['UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS']='never'
p=root/'.local/db.env'
if p.exists():
 for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
  k,v=line.split('=',1); env[k]=v
r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
log=out/(label+'.log'); log.write_text(json.dumps({'stdout':r.stdout},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
record=out/'commands.json'; rows=json.loads(record.read_text()) if record.exists() else []
rows.append({'command':command,'exit_code':r.returncode,'log_path':str(log.relative_to(root)),'timestamp_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}); record.write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'card':card,'command':command,'exit_code':r.returncode,'log':str(log.relative_to(root))})); print(r.stdout[-5000:]); sys.exit(r.returncode)
